g.text: [Description("Adds up the prices held in a Diction
In the development of twinBASIC, the essence of community support has been the
cornerstone of our progress and success. This project thrives not just on code and
technology, but on the invaluable contributions, insights, and feedback provided by a
diverse and active community of developers, users, and enthusiasts.
Portions of this software utilize third-party open-source libraries.
